purpose: README visual design revision on existing draft PR 14

design.concept: A reading atlas: overlapping image planes, camera rays and shared scene geometry
design.typography: Georgia for the decorative hero statement; Arial for SVG labels; GitHub native text for all navigation and paper descriptions
design.layout: Original wide cover; native title and three primary links; four foundational readings in a two-column table; question-first topic table; four dated highlights; collapsed exhaustive categories and confirmed-venue history
design.critique_and_revision: Avoided a generic dashboard and decorative metric cards. Used image planes and point samples tied to the actual research subject. Counts remain script-generated in Markdown. Small cover captions are supplementary; native text retains the meaning at narrow widths.

asset_provenance.collection-cover.svg: Original code-native SVG created for this repository; no third-party visual assets copied.
asset_provenance.images-to-3d.svg: Existing original conceptual diagram recolored to match.

inspiration.principle: Short primary navigation and a collapsed detailed hierarchy.
Separate foundational readings from topic exploration.

scope: README and original SVGs only; paper summaries, source numerical evidence, candidate decisions and automated discovery unchanged.
